edges.description: The mutant PRDM8 pulls laforin and malin into the nucleus in excess.
edges.target: Nuclear sequestration of laforin and malin

edges.description: Without enough cytoplasmic laforin and malin, glycogen is built with overlong strands and becomes insoluble polyglucosan that aggregates into Lafora bodies.
intermediate_mechanisms: effective cytoplasmic deficiency of laforin and malin
edges.source: Nuclear sequestration of laforin and malin

edges.description: In Lafora disease models, Lafora body inclusions drive neurodegeneration; the same step is assumed here.
intermediate_mechanisms: glycogen-driven neuroinflammation, autophagy impairment and synaptic dysfunction

edges.description: Early dysarthria is a presenting feature.
A complicated spastic paraplegia-like presentation was seen in the Iranian family.
Generalized EEG discharges were recorded without clinical seizures in the Iranian family.

evidence.snippet: Early-onset Lafora body disease presents early, at 5 years, with dysarthria, myoclonus and ataxia.

nodes.description: Early dysarthria at onset, around age 5, which initially suggested late infantile-variant neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis.

evidence.snippet: The combination of early-onset and early dysarthria strongly suggests late infantile-variant neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis, not Lafora disease.

nodes.description: Generalized epileptiform EEG discharges without clinical seizures, reported in the Iranian family.

evidence.reference_title: The second family affected with a PRDM8-related disease.
evidence.snippet: Their electroencephalograms showed generalized epileptiform discharges in the absence of clinical seizures.

nodes.description: Myoclonus from onset, progressing as a progressive myoclonus epilepsy.

evidence.snippet: Early-onset Lafora body disease presents early, at 5 years, with dysarthria, myoclonus and ataxia.

nodes.description: Progressive neurological decline giving a progressive myoclonus epilepsy course with dysarthria, myoclonus, ataxia and, in the Iranian family, spasticity.

evidence.snippet: The subsequent course is a typical progressive myoclonus epilepsy, though much more protracted than any infantile neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis, or Lafora disease, patients living into the fourth decade.

nodes.description: Laforin (glycogen phosphatase) and malin (E3 ubiquitin ligase) act in the cytoplasm to regulate glycogen construction. Excess nuclear sequestration by mutant PRDM8 leaves an effective cytoplasmic deficiency of both enzymes, the same functional deficit that EPM2A or NHLRC1 loss produces in classic Lafora disease.
nodes.id: Nuclear sequestration of laforin and malin

evidence.snippet: We show that the PRDM8 protein interacts with laforin and malin and causes translocation of the two proteins to the nucleus.
The mutation, c.781T>C (Phe261Leu), is in a gene of unknown function, PRDM8.

evidence.reference_title: The second family affected with a PRDM8-related disease.
evidence.snippet: Linkage to chromosome 4 and a mutation in the PRDM8 gene were identified, suggesting the patients may be affected with early-onset LD.

nodes.description: The founding variant, PRDM8 c.781T>C (p.Phe261Leu), alters a protein that normally interacts with laforin and malin and translocates them to the nucleus. The mutant protein sequesters both enzymes in the nucleus to an excessive degree, which the authors interpret as a gain of function.

evidence.snippet: The mutation, c.781T>C (Phe261Leu), is in a gene of unknown function, PRDM8.
it therefore likely represents a gain-of-function mutation that leads to an effective deficiency of cytoplasmic laforin and malin

molecular_functions: sequestration of laforin and malin in the nucleus

nodes.description: Insoluble polyglucosan aggregates into Lafora bodies, which were found on pathology in the founding family. Skin biopsies in both families were negative for Lafora bodies, so skin biopsy does not exclude the disease.

evidence.snippet: Pathology reveals no ceroid lipofuscinosis, but Lafora bodies.

evidence.reference_title: The second family affected with a PRDM8-related disease.
evidence.snippet: like the Pakistani family, the search for Lafora bodies in their skin biopsies was negative.

evidence.snippet: Two affected individuals of an Iranian family initially diagnosed as complicated hereditary spastic paraplegia (HSP) underwent careful neurologic examination.
